title: Burung Kakatua Pak Udin
subject: a boy in Baubau who inherits an old cockatoo from the man next door who moved to Kendari, and the bird still calls only 'Udin, makan!' every evening, so the boy starts answering to Udin
caption: Indonesian island acoustic pop in the mid-2020s Wakatobi and Southeast Sulawesi songwriter style. Strummed steel-string acoustic guitar, bright ukulele offbeat chops, gambus lute filling melodic gaps, cajon with soft slap, round bass guitar. Warm open acoustic mix with light room reverb. Male baritone with a relaxed eastern-Indonesian lilt, easy sung storytelling. 98 BPM, G major. Playful, warm, wry. No autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no reggae skank, no electric guitar solo.
lyrics:
[Intro - acoustic guitar and ukulele]

[Verse 1]
Pak Udin pindah ke Kendari
Tinggal kakatua di kandang
Bulunya putih agak kusam
Matanya menatapku lama

[Pre-Chorus]
Jam enam sore tiap hari
Dia teriak dari jendela

[Chorus]
Udin, makan! Udin, makan!
Padahal namaku Rian
Udin, makan! sekali lagi
Ya sudah, aku datang

[Verse 2]
Kukasih pisang, dia diam
Kukasih jagung, dia buang
Ibu ketawa dari dapur
Sekarang ada dua Udin

[Bridge - gambus solo]
Pak Udin telepon minggu lalu
Burungnya diam, malah malu

[Chorus]
Udin, makan! Udin, makan!
Sekarang aku yang jawab
Udin datang, bawa pisang
Kita makan berdua

[Outro - ukulele and cajon fade]
